name: io.github.tonyyang0504/kuaishou_magnetic_engine-mcp
description: 磁力引擎 Kuaishou Magnetic Engine (ads): me, list_campaigns, get_report, update_budget, pause_resume. Ev

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_KUAISHOU_MAGNETIC_ENGINE_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: app_id returned when the 磁力引擎 MAPI developer application was approved (开发者平台 > 应用).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_KUAISHOU_MAGNETIC_ENGINE_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: The application's secret; sent as `secret` in the refresh call.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_KUAISHOU_MAGNETIC_ENGINE_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: refresh_token from 获取token (auth_code exchange after the advertiser authorised the app); valid 30 days and replaced on every refresh ('刷新后会生成新的 token，老的 access_token 和 refresh_token 将不可再使用'). Set PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR so the rotated token survives restarts.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_KUAISHOU_MAGNETIC_ENGINE_ADVERTISER_ID
environmentVariables.description: 广告主 ID returned with the access token at authorisation; used by the probe, update_budget and pause_resume.
